description: The cards a RoTerminal page shows, as data: the same numbers the page draws. A page is a game’s, a studio’s or a developer’s, a member’s, a genre’s, a word’s, or one of Roblox’s charts’. A game’s include Players, Players returning, Similar games, Key stats, On Roblox’s charts, Charts by country, Records, Next milestone, Place in its genre, In Roblox search, After its last update, Store, Badges, When people play and First days. Without card: every card in short (its key, title and first rows). With card (a key from that list): that card whole, as a dataset. A game’s private cards (Robux, players returning, where players come from) are its owner’s alone, as on the page.

card.description: One card’s key from the list (countries, records, search, store, clock…), to read it whole (optional)

page.description: The page: its path or link as find gave it (/g/<id>, /studio/<key>, /u/<handle>, /genres/<slug>, /trends/<word>, /charts/<chart id>), or a game’s name or universe id

name: page_cards
title: A page’s cards
